skills.description: Production-grade Spring Boot engineering standards. Use this skill whenever working on a Spring Boot project, creating new Spring services, implementing features in Spring, reviewing Spring code, setting up Spring project architecture, or discussing Spring Boot best practices. Activates for any Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data, JPA, Flyway, or hexagonal architecture work. Also use when the user mentions modular monolith, microservices architecture, domain-driven design in Java, or production readiness for Spring applications.
